hooks.command: bash -c 'cd /home/bullet/PROJETOS/AnarCry && echo "[hook] Running pre-PR lint gate..." && ./gradlew spotlessCheck checkstyleMain spotbugsMain --no-daemon -q 2>&1 && { command -v semgrep &>/dev/null && ERRORS=$(semgrep scan --config=auto --json --exclude build/ --exclude .gradle/ --exclude gradle/ --exclude src/test/ --exclude knowledge-base/ --exclude docs/ --exclude ".env*" 2>/dev/null | jq "[.results[] | select(.extra.severity == \"ERROR\")] | length") && [ "$ERRORS" -gt 0 ] && echo "FAIL: Semgrep found $ERRORS ERROR issues" && exit 1 || true; } && echo "[hook] All checks passed."'
